scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,UI -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=api" "npm run dev --workspace=ui"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=ui && npm run build --workspace=api
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -n API,UI,ELECTRON -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=api" "npm run dev --workspace=ui" "npm run dev --workspace=electron"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run build --workspace=electron
